title: Cosmic Cowboy on Bull
description: A luminous, ethereal cowboy wearing a hat and pearl necklace rides a glowing white bull through a dreamy sky. The figure holds a lasso as the bull charges forward, surrounded by swirling golden lines, musical notes, clouds, stars, and floating bees in a pastel cosmic landscape.
prompt: A translucent glowing cowboy with long flowing hair, wearing a white cowboy hat and pearl necklace, rides a majestic white bull with glowing horns across a heavenly sky. The cowboy swings a golden lasso while the bull runs through clouds and stars. Swirling golden energy lines, musical notes, and bees float around them in a dreamy pastel cosmic scene with soft iridescent lighting.
